reviews.text: Brenda colors my hair. This time she cut and colored it. I have been getting lots of compliments on it as well as people asking who did it. It really looks good. Getting compliments at my age is very rare. Thanks Brenda!

I have been with Heidi for a long time now.
Got a cut and color last Saturday and let me just say, it's my favorite color and cut!!! I "played around" with it this morning and I can even style it. It looks awesome, I love everything about it.
Kudos to Heidi for another amazing experience!!!

I’ve been going to see Mr. Chris’s salon since I was old enough to get a haircut. It’s always been a 10/10 experience and is worth the 45 minutes to an hour drive to get there. My hair always looks and feels great! 100% definitely recommend.
